title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Fresno
description: Ten under-21-safe Fresno food stops with late-night hours verified through current official restaurant pages. Check the cited page before leaving because hours can change.

cards.title: The Cedar Avenue 24-Hour Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Tacos and customizable fast food north of Fresno State
cards.notes: Check the drive-through schedule, order ahead if useful, and remember that the dining room closes earlier than the 24-hour lane.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Cedar Avenue option whose drive-through remains available after its dining room closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists 5145 N Cedar Ave in Fresno and shows its drive-through as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Fresno, CA — 5145 N Cedar Ave
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the drive-through as open 24 hours daily; dine-in hours are shorter, so use the drive-through late at night.

cards.title: Round-the-Clock Breakfast on Shaw
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour sit-down diner west of campus
cards.notes: Use this stop when you want a table rather than a drive-through; review the official page before departing for holiday changes.
cards.short_summary: A Shaw Avenue diner with all-day breakfast and a restaurant schedule that extends through the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official page identifies the restaurant at 1110 East Shaw Street and lists it as open 24 hours throughout the week.
cards.access_notes: The official restaurant page lists this location as open 24 hours every day and says walk-ins and takeout are available.

cards.title: Shaw Avenue's Overnight Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour drive-through near the campus corridor
cards.notes: Plan on drive-through service after 10 p.m.; the official schedule shows the lobby closing well before the overnight lane.
cards.short_summary: An East Shaw stop where overnight access is limited to the drive-through rather than the lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page lists 1695 E Shaw Ave and shows drive-through hours as 24 hours daily, while lobby hours end at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 1695 E Shaw Ave, Fresno, CA
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is listed as open 24 hours daily. The restaurant and lobby are listed from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 3025 E Shaw Ave
cards.title: The 4 A.M. Shaw Avenue Lane
cards.subtitle: All-day breakfast and fast food east of campus
cards.notes: Arrive by car after the lobby closes, and confirm the daily listing first because the page separates lobby and drive-through access.
cards.short_summary: A Shaw Avenue drive-through that continues serving several hours after its indoor counter closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official location page identifies 3025 E Shaw Ave and lists drive-through service until 4 a.m. with lobby service ending at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 3025 E Shaw Ave, Fresno
cards.access_notes: The official page lists drive-through service until 4 a.m. daily; lobby hours end at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Wings Until 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Late carryout and delivery on East Shaw Avenue
cards.notes: Place a carryout order before 1 a.m. and allow preparation time; both pickup and delivery use the same posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A late carryout counter on Shaw with a clearly posted seven-day closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingstop’s official location page lists 1089 E Shaw Ave, Suite 101A, and shows carryout and delivery hours through 1 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official carryout and delivery hours run from 10:30 a.m. to 1 a.m. seven days a week.

cards.title: Blackstone Burgers After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Drive-through and dine-in seating north of Ashlan Avenue
cards.notes: Choose drive-through or dine-in service, then verify the day: Friday and Saturday extend thirty minutes later than other nights.
cards.short_summary: A Blackstone Avenue burger stop with indoor seating and service past midnight throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out’s official page lists 4302 N Blackstone Ave, drive-through and dine-in seating, and closing times of 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — Fresno, CA, 4302 N Blackstone Ave
cards.access_notes: Normal hours end at 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; both drive-through and dine-in seating are listed.

cards.entity_name: Raising Cane's — 4981 E Kings Canyon Road
cards.title: The Weekend 2:30 A.M. Chicken Run
cards.subtitle: Late drive-through service southeast of campus
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after midnight; dine-in closes at midnight even when Friday and Saturday vehicle service continues later.
cards.short_summary: A chicken-finger counter with its longest service window reserved for the weekend drive-through.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s official page lists 4981 E Kings Canyon Road and drive-through hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's — E Kings Canyon Road, Fresno
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours end at 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes at midnight daily.

cards.title: Midnight Pancakes on Weekends
cards.subtitle: A downtown Fresno sit-down option for Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday and arrive comfortably before midnight; the restaurant closes earlier on other evenings.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-only late option for pancakes, omelets, burgers, and other sit-down fare.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official restaurant page lists 3020 Tulare Street and closing at midnight on Friday and Saturday, with 10 p.m. closing on other days.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast Restaurant — 3020 Tulare St, Fresno
cards.access_notes: The official schedule lists 6 a.m.–midnight Friday and Saturday and 6 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Blackstone Tacos Until 3 A.M.
cards.subtitle: A late drive-through north of Shaw Avenue
cards.notes: Check the location page on the night you go, then use the drive-through for the late window rather than assuming indoor seating remains open.
cards.short_summary: A North Blackstone fast-food stop with an official late-night designation and a 3 a.m. closing listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Fresno location directory lists the restaurant at 5610 Blackstone Ave as a drive-through location open until 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Fresno, California
cards.access_notes: The official Fresno directory lists this location as open until 3 a.m.; verify the direct location listing before departure.

cards.title: The 4 A.M. North First Street Option
cards.subtitle: A far-north Fresno drive-through for the latest window
cards.notes: Treat this as the longer northbound run, confirm the live listing, and use the posted drive-through service for the overnight stop.
cards.short_summary: A farther north alternative whose listed closing time extends to 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Fresno location directory lists 7785 N First Street as a drive-through restaurant open until 4 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Fresno, California
cards.access_notes: The official Fresno directory lists this drive-through location as open until 4 a.m.; confirm the live store page before traveling.
